  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and Infra teams to translate customer needs into thoughtful technical solutions and product roadmaps.

  • Engage deeply in technical discussions, guiding system design decisions and helping the team navigate architectural tradeoffs.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across engineering practices and team processes.

  • Help the team break down complex problems into incremental milestones that deliver value quickly while supporting long-term platform evolution.

  • Ensure teams maintain a strong understanding of the developer experience and customer impact of the features they build.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with product management, customers, and internal teams to understand needs, align priorities, and ensure delivery of impactful features and solutions.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years as an Engineer shipping products and/or features that have downstream impact on the business and product ecosystem. Ideally, experience with building stateful services.

  • 2+ years of experience managing people and developing engineers, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management.

  • Strong technical background with the ability to engage deeply in system design, architecture, and engineering tradeoffs.

  • Product-oriented mindset with experience translating business goals and user needs into engineering roadmaps and shipped features.

  • Ability to balance urgency with thoughtful execution, helping teams ship quickly while maintaining high quality.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability for both team outcomes and long-term system health.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience building products for developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, or DevTools.

  • Background working on highly scalable distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.

  • Experience improving engineering velocity through tooling, processes, and team practices.

  • Experience building products used directly by developers or technical users.

  • A track record of successful collaboration with product, marketing, and customer support teams to drive adoption and retention.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

Render is seeking a foundational Account Manager to build and nurture relationships with our fastest growing and highest potential customers. Our product-led growth model has attracted a significant number of high-growth companies who have scaled their usage organically, and as they grow, it's critical that we evolve from just a self-service solution into a proactive business partner. This role is pivotal in demonstrating Render's long-term value and scalability, owning the commercial health of the relationship, and ensuring our customers achieve their business objectives on our platform.

As the primary business owner for a portfolio of Render's most important customers, you will be responsible for understanding their strategic goals, leading commercial conversations, and driving adoption and expansion. You will proactively identify and mitigate churn risks by reinforcing our value proposition against alternatives managed platform services and hyperscalers. Working in close partnership with our Customer Engineers, you will provide a holistic experience that combines deep technical guidance, knowledge/best practices sharing and ultimately securing our position as a long-term partner in their success.

What You'll Do

  • Manage a large book of ~300 commercial accounts using a 1-to-many, programmatic engagement model—delivering consistent value at scale through proactive outreach and enablement.

  • Build and run scalable programs that drive adoption and expansion (e.g., onboarding journeys, product education series, lifecycle campaigns, webinars/office hours, and targeted nurture motions).

  • Proactively share best practices, playbooks, and technical guidance in partnership with Customer Engineers—helping customers succeed through self-serve resources and repeatable workflows.

  • Identify and prioritize accounts for targeted, higher-touch interventions using health signals and product usage data; mitigate churn risks through timely education and clear next steps.

  • Own and execute contracting motions across your book, including renewals, annualization/commit motions, and standard commercial expansion—working closely with Sales, RevOps, and Legal to remove friction.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Support to surface customer insights and influence the programs, content, and product improvements that will most impact scaled customers.

  • Track and report on program performance (adoption, retention, renewal/commit conversion, expansion) and continuously iterate based on results.

  • Represent Render with authenticity, curiosity, and technical credibility in every customer interaction.

What We're Looking For

  • Has 5+ years of proven experience in a customer-facing role such as Account Management or Customer Success, preferably in the cloud infrastructure or developer tooling space.

  • Possesses a commercial mindset with a track record of successfully managing renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and negotiating contracts

  • Is familiar with using product usage data or analytics to identify customer health risks and expansion opportunities.

  • Is a strategic thinker who can connect the dots between a customer's technical challenges and their overarching business goals.

  • Excels at building rapport and trust with a wide range of stakeholders from senior engineers to C-level executives.

  • Is savvy with product-led growth (PLG) environments and understands how to engage customers who initially adopted a product through a self-service motion.

  • Is a builder who thrives in ambiguity. You are energized by the opportunity to shape a new function and create processes, not frustrated by the lack of standardized playbooks.

  • Has a strong sense of empathy and a genuine passion for helping developers and engineering teams succeed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background at high-performing developer-facing hyper growth tech companies.

  • Experience with hyperscalers and / or cloud platform solutions.

  • Experience helping customers migrate from hyperscalers to managed platform solutions.

  • Experience as a founding or early member of an Account Management or Customer Success team, with a demonstrated ability to help build playbooks and processes from the ground up.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

About the Role

We are looking for Render's first Forward Deployed Engineer to work hands-on with our most strategic customers. Our largest contracts and fastest-growing AI startups are scaling on Render, and this role provides them with a dedicated, concierge-level technical partnership. You will balance two motions: white-glove engagement with our top accounts, where you work closely with the customer's engineering team as a trusted technical partner, and scoped onboarding intensives that get high-growth startups confidently building on the platform. As the first FDE in our Field Engineering organization, you will define the playbook for this function, prove the model, and shape how it scales.

What You'll Do

  • Work closely with Render's top accounts as their dedicated technical partner, providing concierge service across architecture reviews, migration planning, and hands-on delivery.

  • Run scoped onboarding intensives for high-growth startups, from intake and success criteria through hands-on-keyboard execution.

  • Lead the database side of customer engagements, including Postgres architecture, performance tuning, and complex data migrations from Heroku, AWS, and other cloud providers.

  • Drive activation and expansion in strategic accounts: turn major credit grants into durable production adoption, surface expansion signals from your technical work, and partner with the account team to convert them into revenue.

  • Own the ongoing technical relationship for your accounts: proactive architecture and health reviews, collaborative roadmap sessions, incident follow-up and RCA, and escalation point for hard technical problems, working closely with the account team.

  • Build the FDE playbook: qualification criteria, engagement templates, success metrics, and reference architectures that make the program repeatable.

  • Act as a high-signal feedback channel to product and engineering, translating customer friction into prioritized product input.

  • Partner with Account Managers and Customer Engineers to ensure smooth handoffs after each engagement and durable long-term coverage.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role: forward deployed, solutions, customer, or professional services engineering.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals; you can write production-quality code and work hands-on-keyboard inside a customer's codebase.

  • Deep experience with cloud infrastructure: containers, CI/CD, networking, autoscaling, and running real workloads in production.

  • Deep Postgres and database expertise: schema design, performance tuning, replication, and production data migrations. Our largest engagements consistently turn on this skill set.

  • AI fluency: you work with AI tools daily to accelerate your own delivery, and you understand LLM application architectures well enough to guide the teams building them.

  • Excellent communication with everyone from startup founders to enterprise platform teams, including executive-level conversations.

  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; you can stand up a new function without an existing playbook.

  • Commercial instincts: you understand how technical wins connect to expansion, renewal, and revenue.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Migration experience from Heroku, AWS, or other clouds onto modern platforms.

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI and LLM applications (RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, inference workloads); many of our fastest-growing accounts are AI-native.

  • Prior experience as the first hire in a role or a founding member of a new program.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

We are hiring the first members of Render's Scaled Programs Customer Engineering team to help run the technical side of our scaled, digital-first customer motion. You'll support high-growth accounts without dedicated technical coverage, including our startup program cohort, through programmatic, one-to-many engagement rather than a traditional one-to-one model. The role has two halves: running scaled programs (in-app engagement, targeted outreach against expansion and churn signals, webinars) and contributing to the tools and content that power the broader Field Engineering organization (health triggers, growth and expansion opportunities based on product usage, pricing and sizing tools, POC templates, and enablement content). You'll partner closely with our Scaled Account Managers and report into Render's Field Engineering organization.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Scaled AMs and Field Engineering teammates to turn expansion and churn signals (bandwidth, egress, usage patterns) into plays: AM talking points, programmatic outreach, and in-app prompts.

  • Operate startup program onboarding: Intercom checklists, guided flows, and activation follow-up for high-growth AI startups.

  • Partner with Support Engineering to identify recurring mistakes and best practices, then turn those insights into programs and content that reduce customer friction.

  • Build and improve components of our scaled-engagement toolkit: in-app programs, outbound triggers, pricing and sizing calculators (e.g., Heroku and AWS RDS migrations to Postgres), POC templates, and reusable technical enablement.

  • Run scaled customer programs: webinars, Slack community touchpoints, and pattern-based outreach across account cohorts, partnered with Scaled AMs.

  • Translate recurring customer questions and technical best practices into timely in-product guidance and self-service content.

  • Maintain activity tracking and feature-request data hygiene so reliable customer signals flow to the rest of Field Engineering and Product.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role: customer engineering, solutions engineering, technical support, or developer relations.

  • Comfort operating a high-volume, one-to-many motion; you can independently execute clearly scoped programs and build systems and content rather than relying on 1:1 time.

  • Strong fundamentals across cloud infrastructure: containers, deploys, autoscaling, networking, and CI/CD.

  • Working knowledge of Postgres and common database migration patterns (Heroku, AWS RDS).

  • AI fluency: you use AI tools daily in your own workflow, and you're comfortable advising customers building AI-native and LLM-powered applications.

  • Strong written communication; you'll be a primary producer of docs, playbooks, and in-app content.

  • Data-driven, able to prioritize work against team goals, and comfortable asking for context or support when ambiguity could affect the outcome.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Intercom or a similar in-app engagement and messaging platform.

  • Experience building internal or customer-facing tools that scale a team's impact beyond 1:1 work.

  • Experience in a PLG or high-volume account environment.

  • Prior experience with Heroku or other cloud migrations.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

About the Role

The Head of Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem will manage and grow Render's most critical technology partner relationships. This role involves building and executing a comprehensive partnerships strategy — spanning AI ecosystem integrations, hyperscalers and early bets on emerging platforms — that drives meaningful distribution and growth for Render. These partnerships touch nearly every part of Render — Product, Engineering, DevRel, and Business Development — and often involve senior stakeholders at some of the largest and fastest-moving companies in AI, so doing this well means coordinating closely across those internal teams and keeping Render's leadership regularly informed.

The ideal candidate brings real technical depth in AI and developer tooling, paired with a proven background in partner management, strong relationship-building instincts, and the executive presence to engage with partner leadership at the highest levels. You should have a deep understanding of how to build and scale product-centric partnerships — from ecosystem integrations to platform-level bets — in a fast-moving, technical market.

What You'll Do

  • Map Render's technology partnership landscape across AI labs, hyperscalers, and emerging developer products, and build the strategy for where Render has the strongest right to win.

  • Own outcomes for the partnerships portfolio — set clear milestones, timelines, and success metrics (e.g., ecosystem integration, developer adoption, joint launches, revenue impact) and hold yourself accountable to them.

  • Drive day-to-day partnership strategy and execution, taking deals from evaluation through negotiation, launch, and renewal, including commercial terms.

  • Partner closely with Product, DevRel, and Product Marketing to secure roadmap and staffing commitments, drive integration execution, and run co-marketing — and work with Finance and Legal to structure and manage commercial agreements.

  • Scope and lead our thinking on building out a Render Marketplace — including the value proposition to customers and key partners, product and engineering requirements, and commercial and financial terms.

  • Own ongoing relationship management for key partners — acting as their primary point of contact, running business reviews and planning sessions, driving expansion and renewal over time, and serving as their internal advocate at Render.

  • Bring operating rigor to the program: track and report on partnership performance, maintain clear documentation, and keep leadership updated on progress and upcoming launches.

  • Build out a team of partner managers as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • 6–10+ years of experience in strategic or technical partnerships, business development, or product-facing roles at technology companies — ideally where partnerships were critical during a period of hypergrowth.

  • A highly technical background is strongly preferred — former PM, forward-deployed engineer, or engineering experience, particularly within AI — so you can go deep with partner engineering and product teams on integration architecture, connectors, and protocols.

  • Demonstrated success managing and growing complex, high-impact partnerships across AI, cloud, or developer platform ecosystems.

  • Strong cross-functional operating skills, with experience working alongside Product, Engineering, DevRel, Legal, and Finance to execute complex initiatives.

  • Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to use data to drive strategic decisions.

  • Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage at the executive level.

  • Strong bias for action — comfortable operating both independently and as part of cross-functional teams, in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Hands-on experience with MCP, plugins, connectors, or app/marketplace ecosystems specifically.

  • Deep familiarity with the developer tools and infrastructure landscape, and a point of view on how emerging AI-native companies find distribution.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior/Staff Data Engineer to join our growing Data team and set the technical direction for the systems that power analytics, data science, and operational decision-making across Render. As we scale, you'll build and operate the pipelines, services, and infrastructure that make our data accurate, timely, and trusted.

In this role, you'll work across the modern data stack, software and platform engineering, and emerging AI and agent workflows. You'll partner closely with analytics engineers, analysts, scientists, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to translate evolving needs into reliable, maintainable data systems.

As a Senior/Staff-level individual contributor, you'll be a hands-on technical leader—shaping architecture and the platform roadmap, mentoring data engineers, and raising the bar for how we design, build, and operate our infrastructure. The systems and standards you establish will help teams across Render understand the business, make better decisions, and bring new data science, analytics, and AI capabilities into production.

What You'll Do

  • Own our Data Platform Engineering architecture. Set technical direction for core data systems, lead design decisions, and deliver reliable production systems. Partner with Data team leadership to shape the platform roadmap and evaluate architectural and build-versus-buy tradeoffs.

  • Build and operate trusted data pipelines. Develop ingestion services, integrations, and pipelines that deliver accurate, timely data. Make testing, logging, alerting, and observability part of how we build and operate the platform.

  • Evolve our orchestration platform. Own workflow execution, worker infrastructure, upgrades, and operational reliability. Improve deployment patterns and balance performance, cost, and maintenance needs as workloads grow.

  • Own warehouse reliability, performance, and access. Improve our BigQuery environment, including query performance, cost efficiency, permissions tooling, and governance. Partner with Analytics Engineering on warehouse architecture and the foundations that support scalable dbt models.

  • Build cloud services and infrastructure. Develop APIs, event-driven ingestion, and reusable services that connect our data systems. Use infrastructure as code to create maintainable infrastructure, reusable modules, and predictable deployments.

  • Establish engineering standards. Improve version control, CI/CD, testing, documentation, and operational practices across the Data Platform. Reduce technical debt and help the team make sound decisions about tooling and platform evolution.

  • Partner across teams. Work with analytics engineers, analysts, scientists, Engineering, IT, and business teams to clarify requirements, validate outputs, and communicate risks, tradeoffs, and timelines. Collaborate with IT and Security on secure access and data handling.

Applying to Render

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Talent Operations Manager to own the systems, data, and operating rhythm behind how Render hires. You’ll architect our ATS, build the reporting that Talent and hiring teams rely on, and lead process changes that help us scale without losing quality.

You’ll work closely with recruiters, recruiting coordinators, hiring managers, People leaders, and external partners. You’ll make sure our hiring data can answer the questions teams need to make better decisions.

This is a high-leverage role for someone who likes turning messy, fast-moving work into clear operating systems. You’ll help us reduce process drift, improve candidate and interviewer experience, keep hiring data trustworthy, and give the team better visibility into what is working, what is blocked, and where we need to adjust.

We value people who are practical, systems-minded, and steady when the work gets complex. The right person can zoom out to design how the system should work, then zoom in to improve the field, report, access role, or automation that is slowing the team down.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect how our ATS works across custom fields, access roles, interview plans, feedback forms, automations, integrations, and reporting foundations

  • Own the reporting layer for Talent leadership and hiring teams, including dashboards, ad hoc reporting, metric definitions, and visibility into hiring plan progress

  • Keep hiring data accurate and reconciled across the ATS, the hiring plan, and downstream systems so decisions get made on numbers people trust

  • Turn recurring Talent Operations requests into better systems: identify patterns, improve workflows, automate repeatable work, and make the right processes self-serve

  • Evaluate, procure, implement, and manage tools for sourcing, scheduling, reporting, and recruiting operations

  • Build the connective tissue between systems, including API-based reporting, integrations, and automations that reduce manual work for recruiters and coordinators

  • Lead process rollouts with clear documentation, training, adoption checks, and follow-through so changes stick

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in recruiting, recruiting operations, talent operations, people systems, or a similar systems and data role in a high-growth environment

  • Deep ATS expertise, particularly Ashby. You can design how the system should work, not just maintain it, across custom fields, access roles, interview plans, automations, integrations, and reporting foundations

  • Strong analytical skills. You can take a vague question, decide what data would answer it, and build the report yourself

  • Proficient in Google Sheets or Excel. You can pull data together from multiple sources and turn the result into a case a cross-functional partner can follow

  • Experience owning data integrity across an ATS and the systems around it, including reconciling against a hiring plan or another source of truth

  • Strong program and change management skills. You can roll out a new process, teach it, measure adoption, and keep the team aligned

  • Clear written communication, strong documentation habits, high attention to detail, and good judgment in a fast-moving environment

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or scaling a recruiting operations function at a post-Series B/C company

  • Experience supporting technical recruiting teams or high-volume engineering hiring

  • Hands-on experience with the Ashby API or ATS-based reporting

  • Exposure to headcount planning or headcount management systems

  • AI fluency, with good judgment about where AI helps, where it adds risk, and what checks are needed before others rely on the output

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

  • 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

  • Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

  • 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

  • Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

  • Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

  • Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

  • Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

Render is an equal-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior/Staff Data Scientist to join our growing Data team and serve as a strategic analytics partner across Render. As we scale, we're tackling increasingly complex questions across our product, customers, and business, from how developers discover and adopt Render, to what drives engagement and retention, to how we prioritize investments and identify new opportunities for growth.

You'll partner with leaders and teams across Product, Growth, Go-to-Market, Finance, and other functions, focusing on some combination of data analytics, analytics engineering, machine learning, and experimentation based on your strengths, interests, and Render's highest-priority needs. You'll turn ambiguous questions into rigorous analysis, define how we measure success, and translate complex data into decisions and action.

As a Senior/Staff-level individual contributor, you'll also help set the standard for analytics at Render, shaping our measurement frameworks, analytical practices, and how teams across the company use data to make better decisions.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a strategic analytics partner. Work closely with leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Growth, Go-to-Market, Finance, and other teams to identify high-impact questions, frame decisions, and determine how success should be measured.

  • Define meaningful metrics and measurement frameworks. Develop the KPIs and frameworks teams use to understand performance across areas such as acquisition, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, expansion, and customer outcomes.

  • Turn data into strategy. Surface patterns across our users, customers, products, and business. Identify opportunities, diagnose friction, and help teams determine where to invest and what to prioritize.

  • Shape our approach to experimentation and evaluation. Design and analyze experiments where appropriate, develop guardrail metrics and other methods for evaluating initiatives, and help teams choose the right analytical approach for the decision at hand.

  • Build measurement into how we work. Partner with teams to define instrumentation and measurement plans early, ensuring new products, programs, and initiatives can be evaluated reliably after launch.

  • Build trusted analytical foundations. Build and maintain dbt models, semantic and context layers in partnership with Analytics Engineering, transforming behavioral and business data into reliable datasets that support decision-making across Render.

  • Raise the bar for analytics. Establish analytical best practices, improve how teams use data in decision-making, and mentor scientists and cross-functional partners on measurement, experimentation, and data literacy.

  • Help shape the future of analytics at Render. Explore how AI-assisted tools can make analytics faster and more accessible while maintaining a high bar for accuracy, context, and analytical judgment.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of analytics experience, with a track record of shaping strategy and influencing decisions across complex or ambiguous problem spaces.

  • Strong business and product judgment. You can take an ambiguous question, identify what really needs to be understood, and determine the right analytical approach to inform a decision.

  • Experience defining and using metrics across some combination of Product, Growth, Go-to-Market, Finance, or other business domains, for example acquisition, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, expansion, or revenue.

  • Strong SQL skills. Writing complex, efficient SQL and independently exploring large datasets is a core part of how you work.

  • Experience using experimentation, statistical analysis, or other rigorous evaluation methods to understand impact, along with judgment about when each approach is appropriate.

  • Experience with modern analytics tooling such as Metabase, Mixpanel, dbt, BigQuery, Segment, and Git.

  • A track record of influencing cross-functional teams and senior leaders without direct authority. You're comfortable challenging assumptions, creating clarity from ambiguity, and driving alignment around what the data says.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can turn complex analysis into a clear narrative, explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, and build the relationships necessary to drive action.

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding or analytics tools such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code to accelerate analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, or visualization.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Expertise in statistical methods beyond traditional A/B testing, such as causal inference, cohort and survival analysis, or time-series analysis.

  • Experience with developer-focused, product-led, sales-led, or usage-based businesses.

  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, PaaS, developer tooling, or other technically complex products.

  • Experience analyzing multi-product or multi-segment businesses and understanding behavior across interconnected customer journeys.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

Benefits

  • 4 weeks of paid vacation.

As Render scales, you'll build the foundations that turn raw data into trusted, reusable models for analytics, executive reporting, and AI-assisted decision-making.

In this role, you'll partner closely with analysts, scientists, data engineers, and teams across Product, Engineering, Growth, Go-to-Market, Finance, and other business functions. Analysts and scientists will bring domain expertise and own business logic within their areas; you'll own the technical architecture, modeling standards, and engineering practices that help that work scale reliably.

As a Senior/Staff-level individual contributor, you'll set the technical direction for Analytics Engineering at Render—strengthening data quality, improving the developer experience, and building semantic and context layers that make data easier to discover and use. You'll help teams move faster with consistent metrics and maintainable models they can trust.

What You'll Do

  • Own our Analytics Engineering architecture. Guide the long-term evolution of Render’s Analytics Engineering platform, strengthening foundational models so our data remains trusted, scalable, and ready for AI-assisted analytics.

  • Build trusted, reusable data models. Design, build, and maintain governed dbt models that serve as authoritative sources for business-critical metrics across Product, Engineering, Growth, Go-to-Market, Finance, and other teams.

  • Partner closely with analysts and scientists. Help analysts and scientists translate domain-specific business logic into scalable, maintainable warehouse models, moving shared logic out of individual reports and dashboards and into governed datasets.

  • Improve reliability and efficiency. Partner with Data Engineering to strengthen source data quality, warehouse architecture, and BigQuery performance and cost efficiency.

  • Raise the bar for Analytics Engineering. Mentor analysts, scientists, and analytics engineers on dbt development, dimensional modeling, and engineering best practices, and help teams adopt shared standards.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience running dbt in production.

  • Expert-level SQL skills and a track record of designing and owning scalable Kimball dimensional models.

  • Deep expertise in modern Analytics Engineering practices, including Git, testing, CI/CD, documentation, data contracts, lineage, and governance.

  • Experience building semantic and context layers, trusted metrics, and warehouse architectures that support self-service analytics for humans and AI agents across multiple business domains.

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud data warehouse architecture, performance optimization, and cost efficiency, with experience in platforms such as BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake.

  • A track record of establishing technical standards, influencing engineering practices without formal authority, and improving reliability while reducing technical debt.

  • Proven ability to partner closely with analysts, scientists, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable data models.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences and build alignment across teams.

  • Experience building data models that connect product usage, acquisition, CRM, and financial data across the customer lifecycle.

  • Experience using AI-assisted coding or analytics tools such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code to accelerate data modeling, testing, documentation, or exploration.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Hands-on experience with Render’s analytics stack, including BigQuery, Segment, dbt, and analytics tools such as Metabase or Mixpanel.

  • Experience with developer-focused, product-led, sales-led, or usage-based businesses.

  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, PaaS, developer tooling, or other technically complex products.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.

  • Partner with the dedicated product and design partners on both teams to align roadmap with customer, growth, and platform needs

  • Hire and develop engineers to support planned team growth, while keeping both teams' identities and focus areas clear as they scale

  • Make key architectural and product decisions, balancing long-term platform investment against iterative improvements to onboarding and activation

  • Build a strong performance management and career development practice for a team that already includes senior ICs

  • Hands-on enough to review code, prototype, and contribute directly when it helps the team

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, with adaptability and a growth mindset

  • Proven experience building and scaling more than one team, ideally growing a group from a handful of engineers into a larger org

  • Experience managing and developing senior (IC5+) engineers, including hiring and performance management

  • Ability to partner closely with product and design without needing to fill those functions yourself

  • Strong product instincts, with the ability to connect engineering investment to growth and activation outcomes

  • Background from a startup preferred, though experience at a larger company can work too. What matters is the ability to operate at pace

  • Prior growth-focused engineering experience (onboarding, activation, funnel optimization)

As Senior Engineering Manager for Agent Platform & UX, you will lead two teams reimagining Render's onboarding and activation experience for both humans and AI agents.

One team owns the experience a person sees the first time they come to Render: signup, onboarding, activation, and what drives them to adopt more of the platform. The other team builds the equivalent experience for agents, which reach Render through APIs rather than the UI, integrating with providers like Codex, Claude, and Cursor so agents can use Render the way humans do. You'll take an already-forming org through its next stage of growth.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and grow two teams, UX (human onboarding and activation) and Agent Platform (the equivalent experience for agents via programmatic interfaces like the MCP, CLI, API, SDK, and Blueprints)

 - Own the roadmap for Render's self-serve user journey, from first touch through activation, initial monetization, usage expansion, new feature adoption, and PQL graduation

 - Drive the agent-facing side of the platform: build the API-driven experience that lets agents integrate with and operate on Render

 - Partner with the dedicated product and design partners on both teams to align roadmap with customer, growth, and platform needs

 - Hire and develop engineers to support planned team growth, while keeping both teams' identities and focus areas clear as they scale

 - Make key architectural and product decisions, balancing long-term platform investment against iterative improvements to onboarding and activation

 - Build a strong performance management and career development practice for a team that already includes senior ICs


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong people leadership - the top priority for this role

 - Hands-on enough to review code, prototype, and contribute directly when it helps the team

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity, with adaptability and a growth mindset

 - Proven experience building and scaling more than one team, ideally growing a group from a handful of engineers into a larger org

 - Experience managing and developing senior (IC5+) engineers, including hiring and performance management

 - Ability to partner closely with product and design without needing to fill those functions yourself

 - Strong product instincts, with the ability to connect engineering investment to growth and activation outcomes

 - Background from a startup preferred, though experience at a larger company can work too. What matters is the ability to operate at pace


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Prior growth-focused engineering experience (onboarding, activation, funnel optimization)

 - Experience building developer- or agent-facing product experiences, and integrating with AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude, or Cursor

 - Background in developer platforms or DevTools

 - Experience helping a team split or reorganize as it scales into multiple teams

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.
